name: library-sale-watch
what: Checks the library’s page for sale dates and drops any new one into the letter draft. Exists because I missed one, once.

name: event-page-diff
what: Diffs a handful of local venue pages and keeps only the lines that changed.

name: screenshots-to-notes
what: Turns the day’s screenshots folder into one dated markdown note with the text pulled out.

name: letter-assembler
what: Collects the week’s finds, ranks by distance from home, writes the draft, and sends it Friday at seven.

name: site-rebuild
what: Rebuilds this site whenever any of the above writes a line. You are looking at its output.

name: gumroad-builder
what: Built one product end-to-end with an assistant, then stopped. Kept for the build log.
